title: Ferritin–inflammation coupling and iron-restricted erythropoiesis: a negative temporal prediction test
abstract: In NHANES 2003–2004 to 2005–2006 temporal transport among women not known pregnant aged20–49 (n=951 and 1031), a log ferritin×log CRP interaction did not establish improved log soluble-transferrin-receptor prediction beyond flexible marginal routine markers: weighted MSE difference -0.00004309, joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval [-0.00024883, 0.00044668].
